gaps.current_state: Commercial Request and Operations work are separate home concepts; neither alone shows active Shipments, attention, changes, next Shipment, and ready work.
gaps.target_state: One role landing experience with compact status and ranked commercial and operational queues.
gaps.user_impact: Experts inspect multiple pages and prioritize by recall.
gaps.root_cause: Navigation mirrors subsystems rather than the daily prioritization job.
gaps.recommended_pattern: Task-oriented role home and exception queue

gaps.current_state: Shipment facts exist but stage progress, independent tasks, ETA reason, attention, and one next action are not synthesized.
gaps.target_state: Five-second decision summary with current stage, progress, readiness, attention, ETA or reason, and one CTA.
gaps.user_impact: Shipment state cannot be understood at a glance.
gaps.root_cause: Domain components render independently with no cross-domain presentation projection.
dependencies: derived task, attention, and next-action contract

gaps.current_state: Route actions are state and permission derived, but other domains are absent and multiple leg actions may compete.
gaps.target_state: One ranked Shipment-wide action with reason, direct task link, outcome preview, and secondary alternatives.
gaps.user_impact: Users explore tabs and may choose lower-priority work.
gaps.root_cause: Next Action is implemented within the route page rather than the Shipment lifecycle.

gaps.current_state: Card grid exposes dates and source IDs but omits concise attention, current stage, and next action.
gaps.target_state: Sortable priority table or list with seven essential fields and on-demand metadata.
gaps.user_impact: Cross-Shipment comparison and prioritization are slow.
gaps.root_cause: A detail-card presentation is used for a comparison task.

gaps.current_state: Planning, execution, events, references, issues, finance, reconciliation, revisions, checkpoints, and exceptions share a long surface.
gaps.target_state: Operate-first surface with planning and audit detail disclosed separately.
gaps.user_impact: Primary operational work is buried among configuration and history.
gaps.root_cause: Outer route-based IA was decomposed but inner task boundaries were not.
gaps.recommended_pattern: Task header, route timeline, and detail drawers

gaps.current_state: A dual-role admin can see roughly 20 flat tabs spanning people, organization policy, reference data, and system governance.
gaps.target_state: Separate People and Access, Organization Operations, Organization Data, and System Governance workspaces.
gaps.user_impact: Configuration is hard to locate and scope is unclear.
gaps.root_cause: Implementation components and permissions are exposed as peer navigation.

gaps.current_state: Large fact and card stacks surround the current commercial action; discussion, accept or reject, assignment, CRM, Shipment, and history compete.
gaps.target_state: Status and one current commercial action first, with facts summarized and thread or history on demand.
gaps.user_impact: Users may miss the action or read extensively before acting.
gaps.root_cause: A record-centric page grew across the full lifecycle.

gaps.current_state: UUIDs, technical statuses and reasons, raw enums, source IDs, and English labels remain prominent in selected Persian surfaces.
gaps.target_state: Human labels and localized terms are primary; raw IDs and codes are copyable secondary metadata.
gaps.user_impact: Recognition, trust, and mobile scanning suffer.
gaps.root_cause: Technical identity is rendered directly where human display contracts are incomplete.
dependencies: human Shipment label and display-name contract

gaps.current_state: Exact blockers, warnings, and actions exist but no dominant readiness verdict or concise completion count appears first.
gaps.target_state: READY or NOT READY verdict, X of Y completion, ranked blockers, separate warnings, and one close action.
gaps.user_impact: Operators interpret policy detail before they can decide.
gaps.root_cause: Backend evaluation is shown as criteria detail rather than a decision summary.

gaps.current_state: Cargo, route, reports, documents, deliveries, and timeline form a long card page with overlapping current and historical content.
gaps.target_state: Concise outcome-focused overview with domain detail and older history on demand.
gaps.user_impact: Tracking requires scrolling and interpretation.
gaps.root_cause: Internal domain topology leaks into customer presentation.

gaps.current_state: Six correct quantity concepts are split across cards and forms.
gaps.target_state: One comparison matrix per cargo line with unknown and mismatch state plus exact action.
gaps.user_impact: Users must remember values and can confuse cargo truth with allocation.
gaps.root_cause: Presentation follows write models rather than the comparison task.
dependencies: existing cargo lineage and quantity APIs

gaps.current_state: Requirement cards can expose upload, apply, replace, link, remove, review, approve, reject, and verify actions together.
gaps.target_state: Requirement rows with one current action and versions, policy, and exceptional actions on demand.
gaps.user_impact: Action competition slows scanning and increases error risk.
gaps.root_cause: All lifecycle controls are rendered adjacent to state.

gaps.current_state: Position, structured progress, ETA, reason, reports, timestamps, and provenance compete in dense blocks.
gaps.target_state: Current tracking truth and one action first, with history and provenance on demand.
gaps.user_impact: ETA state takes too long to interpret.
gaps.root_cause: Trust metadata is not separated from operational state.
dependencies: existing ETA reason and progress model

gaps.current_state: Partial or final semantics are accurate, but per-cargo cards and creation or correction controls share the first view.
gaps.target_state: Quantity and finality summary plus a focused create form opened by one action.
gaps.user_impact: Current work competes with maintenance detail.
gaps.root_cause: Creation and historical maintenance share the same initial view.

gaps.current_state: Timeline rows expose extensive audit metadata and category filtering applies only to the loaded page.
gaps.target_state: Human event summary, day grouping, full-dataset filters, and raw payload on demand.
gaps.user_impact: Scanning is slow and a filter can misleadingly appear empty.
gaps.root_cause: Audit payload and operational narrative share one level; filtering is page-local.

gaps.current_state: KPI and attention cards create a wall of technical monitoring detail.
gaps.target_state: Compact counters plus ranked, human-readable exception rows.
gaps.user_impact: Experts read every item rather than triage.
gaps.root_cause: Monitoring output is rendered as detail cards instead of a queue.

gaps.current_state: Detailed card items are led by Shipment reference and include many facts.
gaps.target_state: Concise priority rows with stage, reason, action, and expandable detail.
gaps.user_impact: Dense records reduce multi-Shipment scanning.
gaps.root_cause: Operational detail and triage view are combined.

gaps.current_state: Items can lead with technical subject type, public ID, and generic decision-context wording.
gaps.target_state: Human subject label, action reason, due or owner, and outcome-oriented action.
gaps.user_impact: Users translate system objects before deciding.
gaps.root_cause: Governance identifiers are primary labels.

gaps.current_state: Source, quote, route, cargo, and review logic live in a large component with many controls.
gaps.target_state: Guided multi-step creation with persistent summary and validation.
gaps.user_impact: Initial cognitive load is high and errors are discovered late.
gaps.root_cause: The full creation model is exposed at once.

gaps.current_state: Explanatory paragraphs often precede values and actions, and provenance language repeats.
gaps.target_state: One-line contextual help, accessible tooltips, documentation links, and task-specific empty states.
gaps.user_impact: Routine work requires excess reading.
gaps.root_cause: Copy compensates for weak hierarchy and mixed concepts.

gaps.current_state: Forms, current policy, explanatory copy, history, and activation actions frequently coexist.
gaps.target_state: Effective-state summary and primary edit or publish action first; history and advanced controls collapsed.
gaps.user_impact: Current versus editable state can be misread.
gaps.root_cause: Read, edit, and audit modes are not separated.
gaps.recommended_pattern: View or edit mode with version drawer

gaps.current_state: Card-per-record layouts scale vertically and make comparison weak.
gaps.target_state: Compact role-specific rows or table with clear filters and empty states.
gaps.user_impact: Finding an item gets slower as volume grows.
gaps.root_cause: Detail-card pattern is reused for collection tasks.

gaps.current_state: Controls remain usable, but long cards, local navigation, raw IDs, and below-fold actions become expensive.
gaps.target_state: Current state and CTA first, vertical progress, compact section selector, and detail sheets.
gaps.user_impact: Mobile tasks require excessive scrolling.
gaps.root_cause: Desktop content order collapses without reprioritization.

gaps.current_state: Repeated borders, radii, backgrounds, and nested cards flatten hierarchy.
gaps.target_state: Cards only for standalone objects; rows, dividers, and whitespace for related metadata.
gaps.user_impact: The interface feels heavier than its information volume requires.
gaps.root_cause: Card is the default container primitive.

gaps.current_state: Multiple precise dual-calendar timestamps and version or source fields appear together.
gaps.target_state: One meaningful time primary; exact dual time and provenance on demand.
gaps.user_impact: Visual noise slows reading.
gaps.root_cause: Audit precision is shown in operational views.

gaps.current_state: Empty states vary and completion feedback is limited.
gaps.target_state: Positive, action-aware empty and completion states.
gaps.user_impact: The Product feels less guided after success or when no work exists.
gaps.root_cause: States are implemented independently per component.

gaps.current_state: Some actions use technical or generic wording and long LTR IDs wrap in RTL content.
gaps.target_state: Outcome-named actions and consistent isolated, truncated, copyable IDs.
gaps.user_impact: Minor comprehension and layout friction.
gaps.root_cause: Copy and identifier handling vary by component.

gaps.current_state: Label, heading, paragraph, and card title often repeat before the first data.
gaps.target_state: One page title, one task heading, and concise metadata rhythm.
gaps.user_impact: Page length and perceived complexity increase.
gaps.root_cause: Independent components each render introductory hierarchy.
